verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an open-source framework that ships a CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. The built-in pipeline metrics (which the developer enables) and local-inference support are related features, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
